lessons.titleZh: 與別人失去聯繫而感到隔絕

target.pattern: \b(?:cut off from (?:others|the world|the digital world)|cut (?:them|us|people) off from birdsong)\b

brief.meaningEn: Separated from desired contact with people or from an experience in the surrounding world; the context must identify what is no longer accessible.
brief.meaningZh: 與想要的人際接觸或周圍環境中的某種體驗隔開；上下文須指出失去的是甚麼接觸。
brief.grammar: Be or feel cut off from others/the world/the digital world; loud sound can cut them/us/people off from birdsong. Cut is unchanged in the past. The object after from identifies the lost contact or experience.
brief.register: Natural separation phrasal verb for social connection or a specific sensory experience. Feeling isolated does not prove every communication channel has failed; masking birdsong does not prove that every outdoor sound is inaudible.
brief.boundaryZh: 與人隔絕不一定表示所有通訊失效；音樂蓋過鳥鳴也不表示完全聽不到戶外所有聲音。須指出實際失去的接觸或體驗。
brief.misconceptionZh: 留意本人想獨處與缺少想要的互動不同，不替沉默的人假定他喜歡或討厭孤單。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分失去人際聯繫與暫時聽不到環境聲音，說清楚隔絕的具體對象。

listening.en: I felt cut off from others when the art room closed, even though my phone still worked. I missed the small conversations while we cleaned the tables; a weekly message helped, but it was not quite the same kind of contact.
listening.zh: 畫室關閉時，即使電話仍能用，我也感到與別人隔絕。我想念收拾桌子時的短談話；每周訊息有幫助，但不是完全相同的接觸。
listening.promptZh: 隔絕感來自甚麼，而不是甚麼？

options.en: The loss of informal shared conversations, not a complete failure of the phone.
options.zh: 失去共同活動中的短談話，而不是電話完全失效。

options.en: A decision to avoid the group because all contact was unwanted.
options.zh: 因不想要任何接觸，決定避開小組。

options.en: A complete loss of every communication channel, including messages.
options.zh: 完全失去所有聯絡途徑，包括訊息。

options.en: A return to the same daily conversations in the reopened art room.
options.zh: 回到已重開畫室，恢復相同的日常談話。

listening.explanationZh: 電話可用及訊息有幫助，仍不一定取代共同活動中的互動；本人沒有說想拒絕聯繫。

reply.promptEn: Why did you miss the art room despite still having a working phone?
reply.promptZh: 電話仍能用，你為甚麼仍想念畫室？

options.en: I felt cut off from others because I had lost the ordinary conversations around our shared work.
options.zh: 我失去共同工作時的日常談話，所以感到與別人隔絕。

options.en: The messages did not fully replace talking together while we cleared the tables.
options.zh: 訊息沒有完全取代一起收桌時的談話。

options.en: I missed a particular kind of company, not just the ability to send information.
options.zh: 我想念某種相伴，而不只是傳送資訊的能力。

options.en: A working device did not give me the informal interaction I had enjoyed in the room.
options.zh: 器材仍能用，也沒有給我原來在房內享有的隨意互動。

reply.explanationZh: 四句各自說明失去的互動方式，不把可通訊等同所有社交需要已滿足。

scene.promptZh: 自然導賞時，幾名參加者戴着耳機聽很響的音樂。導賞員仍能聽到林間鳥鳴，他們摘下耳機後也聽到了。哪句最準確？

options.en: The loud music cut them off from birdsong while their headphones were on; it did not make the birds disappear.
options.zh: 耳機開着時，響亮的音樂令他們聽不到鳥鳴；這不表示鳥兒消失了。

options.en: The birds stopped singing for everyone until the group took off its headphones.
options.zh: 在小組摘下耳機前，鳥兒對所有人都停止了鳴叫。

options.en: The guide could not hear birdsong either, so the headphones made no difference.
options.zh: 導賞員也聽不到鳥鳴，所以耳機沒有造成分別。

scene.explanationZh: 導賞員仍聽到鳥鳴，參加者摘下耳機後也聽到；被隔開的是他們當時對鳥鳴的聽覺體驗。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不能只從「He felt cut off from others」推論？

options.en: 他感到缺少想要的人際聯繫。
朋友已明確要求他不要再聯絡。
上下文可以指出哪類接觸減少了。

contrast.explanationZh: 隔絕感本身沒有報告朋友曾發出拒絕聯絡的要求；這需要另外的資料。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「電話沒壞，你就不可能覺得隔絕吧？」你想念的是收拾時的隨意談話。哪句回應最好？

options.en: I can feel cut off from others without losing the phone; I miss the informal company, not merely a way to send a message.
options.zh: 電話仍可用，我也可以感到與別人隔絕；我想念隨意相伴，而不只是傳訊息的途徑。

options.en: I thought simply increasing the number of messages could replace the missing conversations, without asking what kind of contact I missed.
options.zh: 我以為只要增加訊息數量，就能代替失去的談話，不用問自己想念哪種接觸。

options.en: I would treat being able to send a message as proof that I do not miss any company.
options.zh: 我會把能傳訊息當成證據，證明自己沒有想念任何相伴。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可傳訊息不等於已有想要的陪伴；訊息數量也不能自動代替隨意談話。應先說清楚想念的是哪種互動。

speaking.en: A quiet place can let me rest without making me feel cut off from the world, provided I can choose when to reconnect.
speaking.zh: 只要我能選擇何時重新聯繫，安靜地方可以讓我休息，而不令我覺得與世界隔絕。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把選擇獨處與缺少聯繫分開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：新同學剛搬來，課後常要照顧弟妹，不能參加晚間聚會；他說想知道同學近況，卻不想在群組解釋家事。用一至兩句英文私下提出一個午間自願短聚或私訊的選項，先問意願，不替他向全班公開原因。

examples.en: I do not want you to feel cut off from others just because the evening meetups do not fit your time. Would a short lunch conversation or an occasional private message suit you, without sharing your family circumstances with the class?
examples.zh: 我不希望晚間聚會時間不合，就令你感到與別人隔絕；午間短談或偶爾私訊合適嗎？不用向全班分享你的家庭情況。

examples.en: You need not feel cut off from the world to keep your family plans private. If you would like, we could catch up briefly at lunch; please tell me whether that would be useful rather than feeling you have to join.
examples.zh: 保留家庭安排的私隱，不必等於感到與世界隔絕；如果你願意，我們可在午間短聚，請告訴我這是否有用，不用覺得一定要參加。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出可自選的具體聯繫方式，先問合適與否，保護對方不公開家事的選擇，不把參與變成義務。

takeaways.en: The letter helped her feel less cut off from the world while the familiar group could not meet.
takeaways.zh: 熟悉的小組無法見面時，那封信幫她減少與世界隔絕的感覺。

takeaways.en: He felt cut off from others after losing the shared routine, although he could still phone the people he knew.
takeaways.zh: 失去共同規律後，他感到與別人隔絕，雖然仍可打電話給認識的人。

lessons.titleZh: 遇到實際安排上的問題

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: First-time organizers often run into practical problems.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page137, table1, row9; unreported locators remain null.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.sentence: New rail projects can run into political pressure.
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 262, row 8; page is the locally rendered PDF page. Proposed same-sense alias only; retain exact source wording as provenance.

brief.meaningEn: Encounter an obstacle while carrying out a plan, whether a practical arrangement problem or political pressure on the proposal.
brief.meaningZh: 推行計劃時遇到阻礙，可以是實際安排問題，也可以是針對方案的政治壓力。
brief.grammar: Run/ran/have run into practical problems or political pressure. Run into names an encountered obstacle; political pressure identifies its source, not its outcome. Run into can also mean meet someone unexpectedly, but that is a different object construction.
brief.register: Natural encounter-obstacle phrasal-verb frame. Pressure may prompt review or negotiation; the phrase alone does not establish cancellation, a specific political actor, or failed preparation.
brief.boundaryZh: 遇到政治壓力不等於工程已取消，也不能單憑片語斷言是哪個黨派施壓；須按情境說明壓力及下一步。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要說明實際阻礙及下一步，不能只把所有困難歸於能力差或惡意。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分現場技術安排問題與方案遇到的政治壓力，並避免把阻礙說成已確定的失敗。

listening.en: We ran into practical problems with the outdoor reading: the benches were fixed too far from the power point for the microphone lead. The poems were ready, but we needed to agree on a different arrangement for the audience.
listening.zh: 戶外朗讀遇到實際安排問題：長椅固定的位置，離插座太遠，咪高峰電線不夠長。詩作已準備好，但我們還需議定觀眾的另一種安排。

options.en: The fixed seating did not work with the available microphone lead.
options.zh: 固定座位的位置配不上現有的咪高峰電線。

options.en: The poems had not yet been selected for the event.
options.zh: 活動還未選好詩作。

options.en: The audience had rejected every proposed reading.
options.zh: 觀眾拒絕了所有擬議朗讀。

options.en: The group had already moved the fixed benches beside the power point.
options.zh: 小組已把固定長椅移到插座旁。

listening.explanationZh: 已準備的內容與現場執行安排不同；困難在座位和器材的配合。

reply.promptEn: Why did you need another audience arrangement?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼需要另一種觀眾安排？

options.en: We had run into practical problems with the fixed benches and the microphone lead.
options.zh: 固定長椅和咪高峰電線的配合，令我們遇到實際安排問題。

options.en: The lead would not reach the available seating from the power point.
options.zh: 電線無法由插座伸到現有座位。

options.en: The poems were ready, but the outdoor setup still needed changing.
options.zh: 詩作已備妥，但戶外配置仍需調整。

options.en: Our equipment did not fit the site in the way we had expected.
options.zh: 器材配合場地的情況，與我們預期不同。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出現場配置的實際障礙，不把問題改成未有內容。

scene.promptZh: 一項新鐵路工程的施工圖與成本估算已完成，但多名市議員要求暫緩批核，先審視居民對路線的意見。工程尚未取消。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The rail project has run into political pressure, although its technical plans are ready and it has not been cancelled.
options.zh: 這項鐵路工程遇到政治壓力，雖然技術方案已備妥，工程也尚未取消。

options.en: The rail project has run into practical problems because its construction drawings have not been prepared.
options.zh: 這項鐵路工程遇到實際安排問題，因為施工圖還未準備好。

options.en: The council has cancelled the rail project after finding that no residents commented on the route.
options.zh: 市議會發現沒有居民對路線提出意見後，已取消這項鐵路工程。

scene.explanationZh: 已完成的圖則與估算不是此處阻礙；議員要求暫緩批核構成政治壓力，但工程尚未取消。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不能由 run into practical problems 推論出來？

options.en: 實際執行時遇到困難。
整個活動已經取消，而且不可能改善。
原有安排可能需要調整。

contrast.explanationZh: 遇到問題不等於已取消或無法解決；結果要按後續資料判斷。

dialogue.promptZh: 伙伴說：「詩稿都準備好，現場應該不用再改吧？」長椅位置配不上電線。哪句回應最好？

options.en: The poems are ready, but we have run into practical problems with the setup; we still need to agree where people can sit.
options.zh: 詩作已備妥，但現場配置遇到實際問題；我們仍需議定大家坐在哪裏。

options.en: I think finished poems are enough to confirm that the seating will work as planned.
options.zh: 我覺得詩作寫好，就足以確認座位能按計劃使用。

options.en: We are still choosing the poems, so the seating issue can only be about the content.
options.zh: 我們還在選詩，所以座位問題只可能跟內容有關。

dialogue.explanationZh: 清楚區分已完成內容與仍需處理的配置。

speaking.en: We have run into practical problems with the setup, so I would like to agree on an alternative before inviting people in.
speaking.zh: 現場配置遇到實際問題，所以讓大家進場前，我想先議定替代安排。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再報告實際障礙及需要議定的下一步。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你答應把班刊做成一大張摺頁，印店卻說那種紙只能印較小尺寸。你想向負責版面的同學說明問題，提出先保留她的設計，請印店試印一張縮小版，再一起看字是否仍清楚；不是直接宣布刪掉她的內容。用一至兩句英文寫訊息。

examples.en: We have run into practical problems with the paper size, but I do not want to cut your design without discussing it. Could we ask for one smaller test print and check the lettering together before deciding?
examples.zh: 紙張尺寸令我們遇到實際問題，但我不想未經討論就刪改你的設計；可先請印店試印一張小版，再一起看字體後才決定嗎？

examples.en: The foldout has run into practical problems because that paper cannot be printed at our planned size. I suggest testing a smaller version of your layout first, so we can judge the text before changing the content.
examples.zh: 那種紙不能按原定尺寸印，摺頁因此遇到實際問題；我建議先試印你的版面的小版，判斷文字是否清楚，再考慮改內容。

glossary.en: a smaller version of your layout

writing.selfCheckZh: 說明外部印製限制，尊重同學的設計，提出能取得判斷依據的試印；不把未測試的方案說成已確定可行。

takeaways.en: They ran into practical problems when the display stand would not fit through the doorway.
takeaways.zh: 展架無法通過門口時，他們遇到實際安排上的問題。

takeaways.en: We may run into practical problems with the room layout, so let us measure the tables before confirming the plan.
takeaways.zh: 房間配置可能出現實際問題，所以確認計劃前，先量度桌子吧。
